title: rarebert
description: AI-powered notification daemon. on hold until there is time to port it to OpenCode V2.

content.heading: rarebert - the AI-driven development loop
content: **rarebert** is a self-modifying scripting environment for interactive, AI-driven development.

content.heading: the loop
content: **rarebert** scaffolds modules, opens them in your editor side-by-side with **opencode**, lets the model implement them, summarises the diff, and commits - then runs the result and remembers what happened.
built around a TypeScript runtime (`lib/runtime/` + bun) that orchestrates $EDITOR, git, and opencode, and a memo subsystem that threads observations between the model and your shell.
each turn ends in a commit, so the working tree is always clean before the next cycle.
the branch is mid-port from Node.js/ESM to TypeScript/bun - not yet stable for daily use.
